title: codemother-reaches-system-word-through-its-package
intention: CodeMother's shim reaches the system_word tool only through its declared interface: the one import at cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:326 names cairn.tools.system_word instead of the undeclared inner module, so the one 'undeclared' encapsulation finding against system_word clears.
why: Measured 2026-10-05: encapsulation_breaches('.') returns one row with target cairn/tools/system_word, reason 'undeclared', from cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:326 ('from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word', a function-local import inside _handle_sealed, added by b984567d8c05). system_word's charter declares only cairn.tools.system_word, whose __init__ re-exports is_word, and every other caller in the repo imports from there. The lived symptom: whoever reshapes system_word's inner module sees no declared caller in codemother, and _handle_sealed (the path every seal crosses a boat through) breaks on a change system_word said touched nobody.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation, CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md); Law 4 (encapsulation_holds is the physics). Child of 8e3474a6ae43 (rule-1-encapsulation), falsifier (3).
how: One line in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py: line 326 '        from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word' becomes '        from cairn.tools.system_word import is_word'. A new proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py reads the live encapsulation_breaches, sealed red before the edit and green after. test_codemother.py (33/33 at HEAD) runs before and after as the regression check.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector.encapsulation_breaches(<repo root>) returns no row whose file starts with 'cairn/devices/codemother/' and whose target is 'cairn/tools/system_word', and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py still reports 33 passed, 0 failed. RED if either fails. WRONG INTENT if system_word's charter meant its inner module to be public. Horizon: PROVED, then the next live inspector pass shows 0 rows on system_word.
watchme: none, because encapsulation_holds runs inside build_inspector (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) at every PROVEME of every component, and its findings ARE the report
children: none, because the change is one import line and one proof

decisions.text:
D1: SETTLED: Create cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py with exactly this content. Its PROVES maps falsifier clause 1 to tooth nothing_in_codemother_reaches_system_word_undeclared. Measured at HEAD before the edit: RED, naming ('cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py', 326, 'cairn.tools.system_word.system_word', 'undeclared'):
"""Proof for ticket 0527c3962d86 — codemother reaches system_word through its package.

RULE 1 (Akien, 2026-10-01): a component is reached only through its DECLARED public interface.
system_word declares cairn.tools.system_word (its __init__ re-exports is_word); b984567d8c05 added a
function-local import in codemother's _handle_sealed naming the inner module
cairn.tools.system_word.system_word. Measured before this ticket: 1 encapsulation_breaches row
'undeclared' on cairn/tools/system_word, from cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:326.

One tooth, over the LIVE repo (an invariant, never a snapshot):

  1. NOTHING IN CODEMOTHER REACHES SYSTEM_WORD UNDECLARED. No encapsulation_breaches row has a
     file under cairn/devices/codemother/ and target cairn/tools/system_word.

    python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py   # exit 0 = green
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
if str(_REPO_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))


class _Late:
    """The inspector resolves AT CALL TIME, so `cairn test --hollow` reads as red teeth
    rather than an import that never ran."""

    def __init__(self, module):
        self._module = module

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        import importlib
        return getattr(importlib.import_module(self._module), name)


_inspector = _Late("cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector")

PROVES = {"0527c3962d86": {"1": "nothing_in_codemother_reaches_system_word_undeclared"}}

SOURCE = "cairn/devices/codemother/"
TARGET = "cairn/tools/system_word"

PASS = 0
FAIL = 0


def _tooth(name, fn):
    global PASS, FAIL
    try:
        fn()
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — a proof reports, never hides
        FAIL += 1
        print(f"  RED   {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    else:
        PASS += 1
        print(f"  ok    {name}")


def nothing_in_codemother_reaches_system_word_undeclared():
    rows = [r for r in _inspector.encapsulation_breaches(str(_REPO_ROOT))
            if r["file"].startswith(SOURCE) and r["target"] == TARGET]
    assert not rows, f"{len(rows)} reach(es) from codemother into system_word off its interface: " \
        f"{[(r['file'], r['line'], r['module'], r['reason']) for r in rows]}"


TEETH = [nothing_in_codemother_reaches_system_word_undeclared]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for fn in TEETH:
        _tooth(fn.__name__, fn)
    print(f"{PASS} passed, {FAIL} failed out of {PASS + FAIL}")
    sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)

D2: SETTLED: The whole code change is one line of cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py, line 326 inside _handle_sealed: '        from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word' becomes '        from cairn.tools.system_word import is_word' (eight spaces of indentation kept). Mechanics: sed -i '326s/from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word/from cairn.tools.system_word import is_word/' cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py from the cairn root, then 'git diff --stat' shows 1 insertion, 1 deletion in that one file. shim.py is code, not a record, so no artifact door is involved. cairn.tools.system_word's __init__ re-exports the same is_word object.

D3: SETTLED: Order and mechanics. (1) Write the proof (D1) and seal it red: 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py'; commit the proof and its validation in cairn. (2) Apply D2 and run 'python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py': expect '1 passed, 0 failed out of 1'; 'python3 -c "from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector import encapsulation_breaches as e; print(len(e(\".\")))"' from the cairn root prints 90 (91 before); and 'python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py' ends 'Results: 33 passed, 0 failed, 33 total'. All three measured in a detached worktree of HEAD with D2 applied on 2026-10-05. (3) Seal the proof green with the same 'bin/cairn test --seal' command and commit shim.py and the validation in cairn. Run each cairn commit in the background and never wrap it in timeout: the pre-commit reseal door reseals codemother's proofs whose closure includes shim.py. Any proof the door times out is resealed by hand with 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 2400 <proof>' and committed.

D4: SETTLED: Nothing else changes. system_word's charter and code, build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches, and every other line of shim.py stay as they are. codemother's other encapsulation rows (its proofs importing the bus device's BusDevice/BusShim, and test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats' reaches) and the librarian row (cairn/devices/librarian/tools/trees/proofs/test_trees_is_a_published_tool.py:131) stay red and are out of this ticket.
